objective: Close the live local-cdev Add/Copy, DMA import, and replacement-generation boundaries before the Linux qualification batch.

lanes.outcome: Provide a real DMA-capable cdev parent/provider and qualify registered-memory mapping through the live device path.
acceptance: The cdev data device has an explicit DMA-capable parent/provider rather than a fixture-only capability.
The live qualification reaches registered-memory map/unmap without the no-DMA-target skip.
Focused kernel and cdev tests pass without weakening capability rejection for unsupported devices.

lanes.outcome: Connect daemon Add/Copy and object-table imports to live lease/query registered-memory handles.
acceptance: Daemon control and cdev data paths bind the same device, view, and generation.
Unmodified Add/Copy succeeds through live registered-memory handles and the mapped payload arena.
Opaque registered-memory handles never become host-pointer casts across the backend ABI.

lanes.outcome: Complete daemon/provider replacement-generation rebind and reference drain.
acceptance: New work cannot use a stale daemon/provider binding after lifecycle commit.
Captured backend, lease, memory, queue, payload, and owner references drain before retirement.
Replacement and same-owner rebind tests prove no duplicate retirement or old-generation admission.
